integrity: Explicit uniform proof and reproducible independent finite graph and chain checks; finite experiments do not certify arbitrary order.
scientific_limitations: Nonequivariant homotopy of the full clique complex of a Latin-square graph, all orders n>=2; no statement on automorphism-module structure or partial-transversal complexes. Previously published field Betti numbers are not claimed as new. No independent audit.
title: Every Latin-square clique complex is a wedge of two-spheres
